data_description.host: ESP32-Divoom is an optional companion firmware that acts as a Bluetooth Classic proxy. If you have it, you can use it instead of connecting to your Divoom device directly via Bluetooth. If not, just leave this empty and Home Assistant will connect directly via Bluetooth.

device_port.title: Divoom device: port
device_port.description: Select the channel/port of your Divoom device.

device_type.title: Divoom device: type
device_type.description: Select the type of your Divoom device.

abort.already_in_progress: A Divoom device with that MAC address is already being set up.
abort.already_configured: A Divoom device with that MAC address is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The discovered device did not provide the information needed to configure it.

entry_not_found.message: No Divoom device found for the config entry {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Divoom device {title} is not loaded. Check whether the integration was set up successfully.

mode_failed.message: The {mode} action failed. See the Home Assistant log for details.

clock.name: Clock
clock.description: Shows the clock channel on a Divoom device. This mode is very limited on older devices such as the Aurabox or the Timebox Mini.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

clock.name: Clock style
clock.description: The clock style to show, as a number starting from 0 up to what the Divoom device supports. Check the official Divoom app to see the available styles.

twentyfour.name: 24-hour format
twentyfour.description: Shows the time in 24-hour format instead of 12-hour format.

color.name: Color
color.description: The color of the clock numbers.

hot.name: Show trending images
hot.description: Cycles through the trending images of the Divoom community.

light.name: Light
light.description: Shows the light channel on a Divoom device. This mode is very limited on the Aurabox, because it only supports 8 colors.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

on.name: Turn on
on.description: Turns the display on, by setting the pixels to black, the brightness to 100 and also switching a specific power flag to 1. Because the pixels stay black and there is no automatic way back to the previously shown mode, you should send another action such as Clock afterwards.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

off.name: Turn off
off.description: Turns the display off, by setting the pixels to black, the brightness to 0 and also switching a specific power flag to 0.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Sets the brightness of a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

image.name: Image
image.description: Shows a static or animated image on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

file.name: Image file
file.description: The image file to display, relative to the configured media directory.

time.name: Frame time
time.description: The time in milliseconds between each frame. Defaults to the timing of the GIF.

text.name: Text
text.description: Shows text as a scrolling animation on a Divoom device. A longer text or a wide font might not fit into the frame limitation of ~60 frames.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

text.name: Text
text.description: The text that will be animated.

font.name: Font
font.description: The font name or filename of the font that should be used. These fonts are included: arcade.ttf, arial.ttf, divoom.ttf, impact.ttf and pixelpowerline.ttf. Defaults to a generic font.

size.name: Font size
size.description: The font size in pixels. Defaults to the screen size of the device.

time.name: Frame time
time.description: The time in milliseconds between each frame. Defaults to 100ms per frame.

foreground_color.name: Text color
foreground_color.description: The color of the text. Defaults to white.

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: The color of the background. Defaults to black.

design.name: Design
design.description: Shows the design channel on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

number.name: Design
number.description: The number of the concrete design, as a number starting from 0 up to what the Divoom device supports.

effects.name: Effects
effects.description: Shows the effects channel on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

number.name: Effect
number.description: The number of the concrete effect. This might differ for some Divoom devices. Look into your phone app and count them.

visualization.name: Visualization
visualization.description: Shows the visualization channel on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

number.name: Visualization
number.description: The number of the concrete visualization. This might differ for some Divoom devices. Look into your phone app and count them.

foreground_color.name: Foreground color
foreground_color.description: The color of the foreground. Only supported by the oldest devices.

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: The color of the background. Only supported by the oldest devices.

signal.name: Signal
signal.description: Shows the signal channel on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

number.name: Signal
number.description: The number of the concrete signal. Look into your phone app and count them.

alarm.name: Alarm
alarm.description: Sets an alarm on a Divoom device. You might have to experiment with the options your Divoom device supports and what it actually changes. Unsupported values will be ignored or if possible directly zeroed, to prevent strange behavior.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

number.name: Alarm slot
number.description: The concrete slot for the alarm. For the actual amount of slots you might have to look into the phone app.

value.name: Time
value.description: The concrete time for when the alarm should happen.

weekday.name: Weekdays
weekday.description: The typical list of weekdays for when the alarm should happen.

alarmmode.name: Alarm mode
alarmmode.description: The alarm mode. Look into your phone app for what is supported by your Divoom device.

triggermode.name: Trigger mode
triggermode.description: The trigger mode. Look into your phone app for what is supported by your Divoom device.

countdown.name: Countdown
countdown.description: Shows the countdown tool on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: Shows the timer tool on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

memorial.name: Memorial
memorial.description: Sets a memorial (reminder) on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

number.name: Memorial slot
number.description: The concrete slot for the memorial. For the actual amount of slots you might have to look into the phone app.

value.name: Date and time
value.description: The date and time of the memorial. The year will be ignored.

text.name: Name
text.description: The name of your memorial, as it will appear in the phone app. Limited to 16 characters. Defaults to Home Assistant.

scoreboard.name: Scoreboard
scoreboard.description: Shows the scoreboard channel or tool on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

player1.name: Player one
player1.description: The score of player one to show.

player2.name: Player two
player2.description: The score of player two to show.

noise.name: Noise meter
noise.description: Shows the noise meter on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

sleep.name: Sleep mode
sleep.description: Shows the sleep mode on a Divoom device, which plays soothing sounds, optionally with a timer and light.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

time.name: Sleep timer
time.description: The time in minutes after which to stop the sleep mode. Defaults to 120 when not provided.

sleepmode.name: Sound effect
sleepmode.description: The sound effect to play. Check in the app how many options are available.

datetime.name: Date and time
datetime.description: Sets the date and time of a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

value.name: Date and time
value.description: The date and time to set. Leave it empty to just use the current date and time.

equalizer.name: Equalizer
equalizer.description: Starts the music equalizer on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

number.name: Equalizer
number.description: The number of the concrete equalizer. Look into your phone app and count them.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Sets the volume of a Divoom device. Only supported by Divoom devices with audio features.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

playstate.name: Play state
playstate.description: Sets the playstate for the currently played music on a Divoom device. Only supported by Divoom devices with audio features.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: Shows and plays the radio channel on a Divoom device. Only supported by Divoom devices with the radio feature.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

lyrics.name: Lyrics
lyrics.description: Shows the lyrics channel on a Divoom device. Might not be supported by every Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

keyboard.name: Keyboard
keyboard.description: Controls the keyboard LEDs, specifically on the Ditoo.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

game.name: Game
game.description: Shows a game on a Divoom device. It is theoretically possible to open games that are not shown in your phone app, but they might not work very well.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

value.name: Game
value.description: The number of the concrete game. Depending on your device you may have a different amount of games. Look into your phone app and count them.

gamecontrol.name: Game control
gamecontrol.description: Sends controlling commands to the currently open game on a Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

value.name: Command
value.description: The command to send to the game.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: The temperature type for celsius or fahrenheit. Without any type the device keeps its current one.

weather.name: Weather
weather.description: The actual type of the weather.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Shows the temperature channel. Be aware, that this mode is specifically for Aurabox or Timebox Mini. It still works on other device, but utilizes the clock mode and therefore might change settings unintentional.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

value.name: Unit
value.description: Changes between °C or °F unit. Defaults to °C.

raw.name: Raw command
raw.description: Sends raw data to the Divoom device. Might be useful, if there is something wrong or not supported by the other modes.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

connect.name: Connect
connect.description: Explicitly connects to your configured Divoom device. Might be useful, if you just want to connect without changing anything. Typically the connection is opened automatically when using any mode.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.

disconnect.name: Disconnect
disconnect.description: Explicitly disconnects from your configured Divoom device. Might be useful, if you cannot connect with your Phone or other devices. Typically this component leaves the connection open to your Divoom device.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: The Divoom device to send this to.
